Firmware

Computer programs and data stored in hardware - typically in read-only memory (ROM) or programmable read-only memory (PROM) - such that the programs and data cannot be dynamically written or modified during execution of the programs.1

How it is Used

Firmware is used in many devices. For example, traffic signal controllers rely on firmware to manage the timing and sequencing of red, yellow, and green lights.
